headline: Loss widens on stepped-up R&D and a one-time IPR&D charge
summary_short: Zenas BioPharma reported a Q2 FY2026 per-share loss of $1.77, widening 21.2% q/q and 41.6% y/y, as R&D spend rose to $62.9 million and the company recorded a $30.0 million acquired IPR&D charge tied to milestone payments.
summary_long: R&D expenses rose to $62.9 million from $43.0 million a year ago, driven by expanded clinical development across the pipeline (obexelimab costs were roughly flat). The company also recorded a $30.0 million acquired in-process R&D charge tied to Xencor ($10.0 million) and InnoCare ($20.0 million) milestone payments. G&A rose $3.6 million to $15.7 million on higher headcount, stock-based compensation, and public-company costs. Interest expense rose $10.3 million on the royalty obligation, senior secured term loan, and convertible notes, partly offset by higher interest income on a larger cash balance ($673.9 million at quarter-end). Management said existing cash funds operations into 2029; no revenue or EPS guidance was given.
confidence_notes: The $30.0 million acquired IPR&D charge (Xencor + InnoCare milestones) is milestone-triggered and non-recurring; excluding it, core opex growth was driven by R&D headcount/trial-cost scaling and G&A public-company costs.
